mapper.select: SELECT id, status, phone FROM public.staff_members WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT s.id, s.staff_code, s.full_name, d.name AS department_name, s.phone, s.email FROM public.staff_members s LEFT JOIN public.departments d ON d.id = s.primary_department_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.staff_member_id = s.id) AND (s.staff_code ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR s.full_name ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR s.phone LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY s.full_name, s.id LIMIT #{limit}
